text: Sunitinib is a multi-targeted receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitor that functions by binding to the ATP-binding pocket of the KIT receptor, thereby preventing its autophosphorylation and subsequent downstream signaling. In Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumors (GIST), where KIT is frequently constitutively activated by oncogenic mutations, this inhibition effectively blocks the proliferative and survival pathways (such as PI3K/AKT and MAPK) driven by the mutant kinase. This mechanism is well-documented and serves as a standard therapeutic strategy for patients with GIST who are resistant to or intolerant of imatinib.
